s.t:

Exceptional academic track record and subsequent career performance

Spreedly is the world's leading Open Payments Platform. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, the company gives mid-market and enterprise businesses the infrastructure to connect to any payment gateway, processor, or fraud tool through a single API. The platform is vendor-agnostic by design, meaning customers are never locked into a single provider and never need to rebuild their payments stack to access new capabilities.
The core business problem Spreedly solves is real and costly: global merchants face a fragmented payments ecosystem, where every new market, payment method, or fraud tool typically requires a separate, time-consuming integration. Spreedly eliminates that complexity, enabling companies to route transactions intelligently, secure cardholder data, prevent fraud, and expand into new markets without heavy engineering overhead.

Spreedly is the payment orchestration platform that lets merchants, platforms, and fintechs connect to hundreds of payment services through a single integration. As we modernize our finance systems, recently moving to Rippling and rolling out Ramp later this year, we are hiring a Senior Accountant to help run a lean, highly automated accounting function.
Reporting to the Accounting Manager, this is a broad, hands-on individual contributor role on a small team. Because routine general-ledger and accounts-payable work is increasingly automated, this role is less about manual data entry and more about ownership, judgment, exception handling, and continuous improvement of how we close the books. It is a strong fit for an accountant who is comfortable across the full close, curious about new systems, and eager to put automation and AI tools to work

Assist with the recurring month-end close: prepare and post journal entries, accruals, prepaids, and amortization; complete assigned account reconciliations; and investigate and explain variances.
Perform balance sheet and subledger reconciliations across the general ledger, ensuring items are supported, current, and cleared timely.
Support accounts payable, accounts receivable, and billing in an increasingly automated environment, including review, exception handling, and controls rather than manual invoice entry.
Process and administer company payroll, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations.
Record and reconcile payroll-related accounting entries (Rippling) and administer equity/stock (Carta), including related reconciliations and reporting.
Support day-to-day expense management, including reviewing, approving, and reconciling employee expense reports and corporate card transactions (e.g., in Ramp).
Take first pass on revenue recognition: enter and configure customer contracts in NetSuite under ASC 606, preparing schedules for the Controller's review and ownership.
Support the outsourced tax function by gathering schedules and requested documentation for our external provider.
Act as a power user across our finance systems (NetSuite, Rippling, Ramp), helping maintain configurations, troubleshoot, and keep integrations running cleanly.
Identify and implement process improvements: streamline close tasks, build automations, and pilot AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort and improve accuracy.
Support the annual audit and maintain clear process documentation for the areas you own.

4+ years of progressive accounting experience, including ownership of month-end close activities.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
Solid working knowledge of U.S. GAAP, including exposure to revenue recognition under ASC 606.
Hands-on experience with a major ERP; NetSuite strongly preferred.
Strong reconciliation and analytical skills, with high attention to detail and accuracy.
Comfort working in a lean, fast-changing environment where you own outcomes end-to-end.
Genuine curiosity about, and comfort experimenting with, AI tools and new systems, and eagerness to adopt them to work smarter. (You do not need to be an expert; we care about the mindset and aptitude.)

CPA (or active candidate)
Experience in SaaS, technology, or payments/fintech.
Experience using Anthropic's Claude in an accounting context.
Familiarity with our stack: Rippling, Ramp, Carta, Maxio, or comparable tools.
A track record of process improvement or automation — examples of manual work you eliminated or streamlined.

Additional Information

Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include:
Connect — A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault — A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.
Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates.
Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve — Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.

To qualify for the position of Accountant (Staff), at GS-0510-12, you must meet the basic qualification requirements listed below. Basic Requirement: A. Degree: Accounting; or a degree in a related field such as business administration, finance, or public administration that included or was supplemented by 24 semester hours in accounting.

The 24 hours may include up to 6 hours of credit in business law OR B. Combination of education and experience: at least 4 years of experience in accounting, or an equivalent combination of accounting experience, college-level education, and training that provided professional accounting knowledge.

Your background must also include one of the following: (1) Twenty-four semester hours in accounting or auditing courses of appropriate type and quality.

This can include up to 6 hours of business law; OR (2) A certificate as Certified Public Accountant or a Certified Internal Auditor, obtained through written examination; OR (3) Completion of the requirements for a degree that included substantial course work in accounting or auditing, but that does not fully satisfy the 24-semester-hour requirement of paragraph A, provided that (a) you have successfully worked at the full-performance level in accounting, auditing, or a related field; (b) a panel of at least two higher level professional accountants or auditors has determined that you have demonstrated a good knowledge of accounting and of related and underlying fields that equals in breadth, depth, currency, and level of advancement that which is normally associated with successful completion of the 4-year course of study described in paragraph A; and (c) except for literal nonconformance to the requirement of 24 semester hours in accounting, your education, training, and experience fully meet the specified requirements.

In addition to meeting the basic requirement above, to qualify for this position you must also meet the qualifications listed below: Specialized Experience: To qualify for the GS-12 grade level, you must have one (1) year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-11 grade level in the Federal service, or comparable non-Federal experience.

Specialized experience is defined as experience performing the following duties: Performing accounting operations involving accruals, reimbursements, billings, invoices, collections, and/or financial transaction validations. AND Resolving accounting and internal controls issues and recommend corrective actions or process improvements.

AND/OR Analyzing financial data and preparing reports, dashboards, and/or recommendations to support management decision-making. Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein.
Hier hast du die Möglichkeit dein erlerntes Wissen im Accounting einzubringen und dich in einem Unternehmensumfeld mit viel Potential und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten weiterzuentwickeln.
Unser Kunde ist eine wachsende Unternehmensgruppe, die spezialisierte Softwareunternehmen für den öffentlichen Sektor unter einem Dach vereint. Der Fokus liegt auf zukunftsrelevanten Bereichen wie Mobilität, Energie und öffentlicher Sicherheit.
Aufgaben
Als Accountant betreust du eigenverantwortlich zwei bis drei Softwaregesellschaften und sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Finance Team der Unternehmen für verlässliche Abschlüsse und skalierbare Accounting Prozesse.
Abschlussverantwortung: Erstellung von Monats, Quartals und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB und IFRS für mehrere Gesellschaften.
Accounting: Steuerung der laufenden Finanzbuchhaltung von Hauptbuch und Anlagen bis hin zu Debitoren, Kreditoren und Kontenabstimmungen.
Software Bilanzierung: Abbildung spezifischer Geschäftsvorfälle rund um Softwarelizenzen, SaaS Modelle, Projektgeschäft sowie Wartungs und Supportverträge.
Steuern & Internationales: Erstellung von Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen sowie Bearbeitung grenzüberschreitender Sachverhalte und Unterstützung bei Jahressteuererklärungen.
Intercompany: Abstimmung und Verrechnung von Geschäftsvorfällen innerhalb der internationalen Unternehmensgruppe.
Systeme & Digitalisierung: Aktive Mitwirkung bei der Einführung von Odoo sowie bei der Automatisierung und Weiterentwicklung der Accounting Prozesse und Systemschnittstellen.
Stakeholder Management: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Finance Teams und der Geschäftsführung sowie zentrale Ansprechperson für Wirtschaftsprüfer, Steuerberater, Banken und Betriebsprüfer.
Qualifikation
Kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Studium mit Schwerpunkt Accounting, Rechnungswesen oder Steuern. Eine Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK) ist von großem Vorteil, aber kein Muss.

Sicherer Umgang mit Buchhaltungssoftware und gute Excel-Kenntnisse sowie Interesse an Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und der Einführung neuer Systeme.
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse
Hohe Eigenständigkeit, Genauigkeit und Hands on Mentalität sowie Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Strukturen weiterzuentwickeln.
Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team sowie Motivation, sich fachlich und perspektivisch weiterzuentwickeln.
Wichtig: Lust und Motivation in einer dynamischen Umgebung zu lernen und zu wachsen, die Unternehmensgruppe bietet viel Potential und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Du behältst im Zahlendschungel immer den perfekten Überblick und brennst für lückenlose, saubere Buchhaltungsprozesse? Bei benuta steuerst du genau die Buchungsprozesse und Konten, die unser starkes internationales Wachstum im E-Commerce sauber absichern.

Wenn du Lust hast, echte Verantwortung im Daily Business zu übernehmen, Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse aktiv mitzugestalten und als verlässlicher Sparringspartner für interne Teams und Lieferanten zu agieren, dann ist das hier deine nächste Challenge!
Deine Aufgaben
Ganzheitliche operative Buchhaltung: Du übernimmst die operative Gesamtverantwortung für alle Buchungsvorgänge im Bereich der Kreditoren, Debitoren sowie des gesamten Zahlungsverkehrs.
Kontenklärung & -abstimmung: Du verantwortest die Erfassung, Prüfung und Buchung sämtlicher Geschäftsvorfälle und sorgst für die präzise, kontinuierliche Abstimmung der Debitorenkonten.
Digitales Rechnungsmanagement: Du verwaltest und steuerst den Rechnungsfreigabeprozess effizient über unser zentrales Dokumentenmanagementsystem.
Abschlusssicherheit nach HGB: Bei den Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB stellst du eigenverantwortlich sicher, dass deine Buchungsbereiche zum Stichtag absolut „sauber“ und fehlerfrei sind.
Schnittstellenfunktion & Support: Du agierst als zentrale*r Ansprechpartner*in für interne Abteilungen sowie externe Lieferanten und unterstützt das Team tatkräftig bei betriebswirtschaftlichen Auswertungen und Reports.
Stellenanforderungen
Dein Profil
Fundierte Ausbildung & Praxiserfahrung: Du bringst eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Fokus auf die Buchhaltung (idealerweise mit fachspezifischer Weiterbildung) oder ein vergleichbares Studium mit und verfügst über mindestens zwei Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung.
HGB- & System-Expertise: Du bist absolut sattelfest in der Rechnungslegung nach HGB und bringst fundierte Praxiserfahrung im Umgang mit gängigen ERP-Systemen (z. B. DATEV, SAGE) mit.
Digitales Mindset: Der Umgang mit modernen Office-Produkten (MS Office, Google Suite) gehört für dich zum täglichen Handwerkszeug.
Strukturierte Detailgenauigkeit: Dein Herz schlägt für optimierte Prozesse in der Finanzbuchhaltung – du zeichnest dich durch analytisches Denkvermögen, Detailgenauigkeit und ein hohes Maß an Zuverlässigkeit aus.
Ownership & Teamgeist: Du überzeugst durch ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise und eine gesunde Portion Kommunikationsstärke.
Sprachkompetenz: Du kommunizierst absolut verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch (in Wort und Schrift).

Präsenz & Flexibilität: Unser Fokus liegt auf der gemeinsamen Arbeit vor Ort an unserem Campus. Für die nötige Flexibilität in deiner Alltagsplanung - sei es für private Termine oder ungestörtes Arbeiten - bieten wir dir ein jährliches Kontingent von 26 Home-Office-Tagen.
Unser neuer Campus "benuta One": Du arbeitest nicht in irgendeinem Büro. Ab Mitte 2027 ziehen wir in unseren brandneuen, hochmodernen Unternehmenscampus, der genau darauf ausgelegt ist, dass die Arbeit vor Ort Spaß macht - mit State-of-the-Art-Arbeitsplätzen, modernen Meetingräumen und viel Platz für echten Team-Spirit.
Deine Mobilität: Egal wie du zu uns kommst, wir unterstützen dich. Du hast die Wahl zwischen einem vergünstigten Jobticket oder einer Tankkarte. Zudem bieten wir dir ein Firmenrad-Leasing (JobRad), E-Ladesäulen vor Ort und eine gute ÖPNV-Anbindung.
Rundum-Verpflegung: Wir stärken dich im Alltag. Dein Frühstück geht komplett auf uns, und für die Mittagspause bieten wir dir eine bezuschusste Verpflegungsoption. Dazu gibt es jederzeit frisches Obst sowie kostenfreien Kaffee, Hafermilch und eine Auswahl an kalten Getränken.
Zeit für Erholung: Du erhältst 28 Tage Urlaub und profitierst von unserem flexiblen Gleitzeitmodell. Weihnachten und Silvester sind bei uns grundsätzlich arbeitsfreie Tage, die nicht von deinem Urlaubskonto abgehen.
Deine Entwicklung & Kultur: Ein strukturiertes Onboarding ab Tag eins, flache Hierarchien und viel Freiraum für deine eigenen Ideen unterstützen dich bei deinem nächsten Karriereschritt. Übrigens: Bei uns gilt come as you are – und auch dein Hund ist im Büro herzlich willkommen!
Klingt nach deinem nächsten Match? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Lade einfach deinen Lebenslauf und deine relevanten Zeugnisse über unser Online-Portal hoch.
Dein Ansprechpartner ist Rene Orbach (VP Finance) .
*Bei uns zählt der Mensch und seine Motivation - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion oder sexueller Orientierung. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit einer Schwerbehinderung oder ihnen Gleichgestellten werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.
Über benuta
Seit 2008 revolutionieren wir von Bonn aus den europäischen Teppich- und Home-&-Living-E-Commerce. Mit über 100 Millionen Euro Umsatz, modernster AI-gestützter Produktinszenierung und Kunden in 17 Ländern verbinden wir die Sicherheit eines etablierten Marktführers mit dem Drive und den flachen Hierarchien eines Digital-Pioneers. Unser Ziel ist einfach: Jedes Zuhause noch schöner zu machen. Werde Teil unseres Teams und hilf uns dabei, noch mehr Menschen für unsere Produkte zu begeistern.

The Company You’ll Join
Carta is the connected platform and AI-native ecosystem for private capital. Built to replace fragmented tools with a single system of record, Carta brings together the software, services, and legal infrastructure that founders use to manage equity, fund managers use to run administration and reporting, and legal teams use to close transactions.

Trusted by 55,000 companies and 1.8M+ equity holders in 160+ countries, and 10,000 funds and SPVs representing $250B+ in assets under management, Carta is transforming how private capital operates. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work.
For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page .
The Problems You'll Solve
At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As a Billing & Revenue Accountant, you’ll work to:
Own end-to-end billing accuracy — validate and process source data through Carta's AI-powered workflow, execute bulk imports, and generate client invoices in NetSuite with precision and speed
Close the data gap — proactively identify missing or inconsistent billing data and partner with stakeholders across the business to resolve issues before they reach the client
Drive collections excellence — manage outstanding balances through YayPay, ensuring professional follow-up that protects client relationships while keeping aging receivables in check
Serve as the billing point of contact for clients — respond to billing queries with clarity and accuracy, meeting the professional standard expected in a complex, high-touch environment
Support a clean month-end close — post and reconcile accrued revenue entries so financial statements reflect reality accurately and on time
Make the process better — identify friction points in the billing cycle and help embed AI-driven improvements that scale with Carta's growth

As a key member of the accounting team, this position will collaborate closely with the Revenue team and Controller to support Carta’s revenue operations. In this role, you will join a highly dynamic team dedicated to driving Carta’s growth and developing new processes.

We are seeking an experienced professional to assist with revenue recording and reconciliation, as well as conducting technical accounting analysis of contracts for revenue recognition.

This position will serve as a key liaison between the accounting team and various departments, including sales, legal, finance, delivery teams, deal desk, and accounts receivable.

Complex billing background. 4+ years of relevant experience recommended. You've worked in a demanding billing environment at a law firm, professional services firm, or within private equity or fund administration — and are comfortable navigating large, multi-source datasets accurately and efficiently.
Detail-oriented by default. You self-review everything before it goes out. You catch what others miss and build habits that make that consistency repeatable and reliable
Proactive communicator. You surface problems early, come with solutions, and keep stakeholders informed without being asked. Clients and colleagues trust you because you're clear, timely, and professional
AI-curious and tool-savvy. You're genuinely interested in how AI can improve finance workflows and you adapt quickly to new platforms. Experience using Claude or other AI tools professionally is a strong advantage
Accounting-fluent. You're comfortable with revenue recognition principles, accrued revenue postings, and month-end close. AAT Level 4, part-qualified ACCA/CIMA, or equivalent hands-on experience
Systems-oriented. Experience with NetSuite and/or YayPay (or comparable platforms) is a plus and even without it, you pick things up fast
At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

Möchten Sie das regulatorische Meldewesen für eine etablierte Basler Privatbank verantworten \- dort, wo Zahlen, Aufsichtsrecht und Bankbetrieb zusammenkommen?
Dann sind Sie bei **E. Gutzwiller \& Cie, Banquiers** am richtigen Ort!
Wir sind eine unabhängige Privatbank mit Fokus auf Vermögensverwaltung und individuelle Kundenbetreuung. In der Schlüsselrolle stellen Sie sicher, dass unsere aufsichtsrechtliche Meldungen und Nachweise termingerecht, korrekt und nachvollziehbar sind und bringen Ihr Wissen dort ein, wo neue regulatorische Anforderungen in Prozesse und Systeme überführt werden müssen.

The Senior Trade Accountant will be based in Geneva, Switzerland within the Accounting & Controlling Department, operating in a Trading & Shipping environment. The role is responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and robust accounting and financial reporting in compliance with IFRS norms.
As a senior finance professional, the incumbent will play a key role in safeguarding the integrity of trading results, maintaining proper accounting books under IFRS, and supporting the business through high-quality financial analysis, reporting, and internal controls.

Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance, or an equivalent professional qualification (e.g. ACCA)
Work Experience
6 to 8 years of experience within a Commodity Trading environment.
Prior exposure to the Oil industry and/or a Trading & Shipping environment is a strong advantage.
Prior audit experience is a plus.
Language Skills
Fluent in both written and spoken English, French is a plus.
Functional Skills
Strong ability to analyse, interpret, and prepare financial statements in accordance with IFRS.
Proven ability to prepare, coordinate, and follow up on audit processes and requirements.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to review balance sheets, P&L accounts, and month-end/year-end closing activities.
Excellent knowledge of accounting systems and financial trading platforms.
Advanced IT literacy with excellent proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.

1. Trade & Financial Accounting
Control and account for the accounting impact of paper trades.
Prepare detailed P&L analysis by voyage, ensuring inclusion of all primary and secondary costs.
Analyse and monitor overhead expenses.
Proactively identify incomplete or missing information and ensure timely completion and correction.
2. Reconciliations, Balance Sheet and P&L production and control
Reconcile balance sheet accounts, including but not limited to accounts receivable, accounts payable, banks, and intercompany balances.
Reconcile Accounting P&L to Trading P&L and investigate and resolve discrepancies.
Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of accounting records.
Perform and resolve intercompany reconciliations.
3. Reporting, Audit & Compliance
Prepare monthly and quarterly management accounts.
Handle usual Year-end financial audit end-to-end process up to sign-off.
Ensure accurate organisation, maintenance, and control of accounting records and document flows.
Promote strong internal controls and compliance with internal policies and IFRS accounting standards.
4. Business Partnering
Liaise closely with all departments teams to resolve accounting discrepancies and ensure accurate data for proper accounting process.
Support Accounting initiatives, ad-hoc analyses, and continuous improvement projects.

Analytical Thinking
Demonstrates a strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret large datasets, identify discrepancies, and resolve issues logically, efficiently, and accurately in a fast-paced trading environment.
Planning & Organizing
Rigorous attention to detail. Effectively prioritises activities, plans and tracks progress, and ensures objectives are delivered within agreed timelines and quality standards.
Collaboration
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across multiple locations and departments. Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a constructive and solution-oriented approach.
Discretion
High level of discretion and confidentiality required due to access to sensitive commercial, financial, and strategic information. Ability to adapt to the company's culture and values.
